reviewedBoundaries.finding: Six finite provider requests; exact advertised schemas, issued call IDs, current awaited result, selected block/text and scope; duplicate or unissued calls/results rejected. Registered unselected-text canary and pre-consent selected-text canary are checked in keys, values and bounded nested JSON.

Cancellation uses the actual sanctioned host refusal string; successful create returns the actual empty content contract. Fixture status alone cannot prove cancellation UI or native creation; the mounted UI test separately checks prompts, refusal/allow actions, cancelled-title absence, empty created page and original source preservation.

Provider serialization covers state acceptance, response writes/flushes and response-delivered bookkeeping; an actual next-request-after-DONE regression passes. This server bookkeeping is not proof that the client application consumed the response.

Accepted sockets receive explicit shutdown and close, and owned handler threads are joined with the unchanged five-second bound. A three-second fixture-only partial-request read bound addresses the retained Windows shutdown failure. Stop separately verifies exact process birth identity and actual exit.

GetExtendedTcpTable uses AF_INET and OWNER_PID_LISTENER; native ctypes table offset and row size, bounded size retries/count/buffer, LISTEN state and network-order low-16-bit port conversion are checked. Actual owned positive/negative listener regression prevents an always-empty observation from passing. API errors remain failures; no unrelated rows are emitted.

One owned HTTPS loopback listener, explicit private CA, default client trust behavior in the mounted helper, and simulator-specific root installation by the wrapper. No host/global trust modification, public listener, packet capture or driver installation.

Lifecycle includes imported test scenario source in its before/after source map and fails on source drift or incomplete cleanup. Canonical verifier compares type-preserving canonical JSON and fails its source stability gate. Outer v3 receipt binds all six fixture directory inputs.

Safe reports use fixed codes, counts, booleans, UUIDs and hashes; private TLS/admin config and provider bodies are not safe evidence. Raw xcresults and workflow logs require separate screening before repository archival.

Child exit was observed but an active connect to the closed port timed out; final v3 uses the bounded query-only native listener table with a positive/negative control. This observation does not establish a cause for the unrelated Any HTTP timeout.

limitations: Fixture controls, saved-snapshot decoding and canonical response equivalence are not a mounted Apple Hanlin acceptance result.
The wrapper's simulator trust command and TEST_RUNNER propagation still require actual Apple execution.
Canary inspection is bounded and is not a general claim about all encodings.
A native HTTP access-log completion or fixture response-delivered flag is not proof of socket delivery to the client.
No root cause or production transport fix for the unresolved Any timeout is established by this review.
